Emily / Jane —

Thanks again for a great discovery today. Quick recap and the items we agreed on so thereare clear next steps: 

- Scope: 6-week pilot, 3 models (search ranking, triage summarization, internal QA assistant).
- Success metric: 20% improvement in triage throughput for the pilot cohort.
- Data: customer data will remain in us-west region; Acme preferred retention = 90 days.
- Security: you asked for SOC 2 and KMS/HSM details; attaching our SOC excerpt and the redlined terms for procurement.

Next steps (Im putting these in the hubspot playbook):
1) Im shared the initial contract + redlines with counsel (attached): Redwood-Acme-MAP-v1.pdf and Redwood-SaaS-Terms-Redlines-20260320.docx.
2) Jane / counsel to confirm high-level legal items and any procurement constraints (liability cap, data residency, audit rights).
3) If procurement wants a follow-up call, happy to schedule a 15-minute slot next week — Monica (SE) will join for technical Qs.

If you have a target procurement window, please share so we can align capacity and pricing (we can support a short-term reserved pool if required).

Thanks — appreciate the time.

—
